context.body: This is explicit covenant instruction given generations before Moses’ journey.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: God commands Abraham and his offspring to circumcise every male as a sign in the flesh.
observations.label: Circumcision is named as a covenant sign: action

observations.body: An uncircumcised male is to be cut off from his people because he has broken the covenant.
observations.label: Circumcision is named as a covenant sign: response

observations.body: covenant · every male · foreskin · sign · cut off · broken covenant
observations.label: Words in Genesis 17:9–14

payload.posture: Read Genesis 17:9–14 as circumcision in covenant instruction evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The instruction makes circumcision’s covenant weight visible, but Exodus 4 does not explicitly cite Genesis 17 or identify covenant breach as the reason for the attack.
payload.title: Circumcision is named as a covenant sign
